## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 13, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Dae June_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "A lot of the basic functions that were free before are now behind a paywall. As someone who really enjoyed the app, I hate this change v and will be trying to find something else."
            2. _Ryaan55555lllAaaannddd_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Literally can do nothing without premium access. I tried searching up the word “egg” and it said theres no options in the menu. Absolute trash for user interface. Could not find anyway to search for eggs anywhere else except in my “history” options. Every button you click asks you to go premium. This app is a waste of time. I was relaxed and now upset and irritated because i couldn’t even find “eggs” as an option to add my calories. Trash trash trash"
            3. _JMmC47_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Everything that made this app great to use in the past is now behind a paywall. The adds are pervasive and pop ups infuriating. I would rather use literally any other program. I may have considered paying once I got back in the habit, but just make it awful to use from the get-go is a frustration that makes me not even care enough to risk if that is still true behind the paywall."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      3 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 9, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kodefuguru_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "MyFitnessPal’s ads on AMC+ are substantially louder than the shows and every other commercial. It is extremely irritating to have to grab the remote and mute the television every time one comes on. Congratulations: your advertising was effective. It persuaded me to download the app—specifically so I could give it one star."
            2. _hazicles_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Have been using the platform for a long time. It’s now full of ads to force you to buy premium. The interface has changed as well to now be more difficult to use. Such a shame"
            3. _FoDu1379_, Aug 16, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve had and used the app off and on for several years. Seems lately the goal for them to make more money has become their #1 priority. Almost $7 a month is a bit pricey for a user like myself, so I put up with the banner ads- no problem. But, with the last update…. now, after you log your first meal your greeted with a full screen ad or video where the close button, if available, is very difficult to find. I usually close the app and reopen it to get back to the app. This process is extremely annoying, and feels overblown. I’d look elsewhere if you’re new to a calorie/fitness app."
<!--/ir-theme-->
